name: Maido
summary: Maido is the most polished Nikkei tasting experience in Lima, for diners who want a headline meal and like rich, saucy fusion cooking. Reviews are split: many love it, a recurring minority prefer Kjolle, Mérito or Central for ingredient storytelling and calmer service. It sells out early; the free per-shift waitlist on its booking page is the usual way in.
